title: Sequencing with Antes de and Después de

sections.content: Use *antes* de and *después* de to put two actions in order. A useful pattern is He *lavado* las *manos* antes de *empezar*. You can also put the sequence phrase first: Después de *cocinar*, *hemos* *probado* la *comida*.

items.spanish: Antes de empezar, hemos lavado las manos.
items.english: Before starting, we have washed our hands.

items.spanish: Después de lavar las manos, hemos preparado los ingredientes.
items.english: After washing our hands, we have prepared the ingredients.

items.spanish: Antes de cocinar, hemos cortado las verduras.
items.english: Before cooking, we have cut the vegetables.

items.spanish: Después de cocinar, hemos probado la comida.
items.english: After cooking, we have tasted the food.

sections.content: The verb after *antes* de and *después* de stays in the infinitive: antes de *cocinar*, después de cocinar.
